name: Caramel colours
aliases: E150a, E150b, E150c, E150d, caramel colours, caramel colors, caramel colour, caramel color, Class I caramel, Class II caramel, Class III caramel, Class IV caramel, burnt sugar colour
what_is: A family of four brown food colours made by controlled heating of carbohydrates, with the classes distinguished by the reagents permitted during manufacture.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because the generic term caramel colour can cover four distinct classes with different manufacturing specifications, and some labels do not identify the class.
can_1: Identify E150a, E150b, E150c or E150d when the class is declared and recognise generic caramel colour wording.
can_2: Trigger the E-number and Woman layers while keeping the class distinction explicit and avoiding a sex-specific conclusion from the label alone.
cannot_1: Infer the exact caramel class when the label only says caramel colour or caramel color.
cannot_2: Measure process by-products such as 4-methylimidazole or determine their concentration from label text.
title: Caramel colours
description: A family of four brown food colours made by controlled heating of carbohydrates, with the classes distinguished by the reagents permitted during manufacture.
